record_title: Exact underdamped rate law for the pure single-loop minimax feedback method
provenance: Exact spectral analysis of the fixed-parameter damped extragradient method in arXiv:2609.20327v1 on separable strongly convex--strongly concave quadratics, including an all-condition-number underdamping certificate and near-Jordan asymptotics.
limitations: The exact all-kappa discriminant certificate is for kappa_x=1, while arbitrary fixed kappa_x is treated asymptotically as kappa_y grows. The result is source-specific and separable; it is not an oracle lower bound, does not optimize the published parameters, and does not claim the same constants for coupled nonlinear problems.
